[SWS_CM_10493] Local Access Control Activation
⌈
If IamModuleIn-
stantiation.localComAccessControlEnabled is defined and is set to false, CM
shall perform no local access control, i.e., no access to any service from a local Pro-
cess shall be restricted because of missing ComGrants. If IamModuleInstanti-
ation is defined on the Machine and IamModuleInstantiation.localComAc-
cessControlEnabled is not defined or is set to true, CM shall perform local access
control.
⌋
